cars.generation: S54 original six-cylinder Skyline 2000GT road saloon family
cars.specification_market: Nissan Heritage No.291 identifies the 1965 Prince S54B-2 road 2000GT, not an ordinary 1500 or later C10. The page contains an unrelated Caball image-alt label; its model heading and explicit technical table identify the selected car. No unprinted gearbox or conversion of its native kW/PS notation is invented. The short story supports the original S54 racing origin only: its race-car setup is not the selected 1965 road specification. Race replicas and later S54B-3/GT-B revisions are not extra records.
cars.summary: Prince’s S54 Skyline established the sporting identity that later made the Skyline name famous. Its lengthened body accommodated a six-cylinder engine, and the family’s 1964 Japanese Grand Prix challenge against the Porsche 904 helped create one of Japan’s enduring performance-car legends.

cars.generation: Original PR91W 1600 GT-R twin-cam road coupe family
cars.variant: 1600 GT-R — July 1970 base production recognition, four-speed
cars.specification_market: Original Isuzu/JAF T-127, FIA1604 Group II production reference, valid from 1 July 1970. All 16 PDF pages rendered in a contact sheet; base PDF1/4–7/9/14 individually read. The complete file contains the original fourteen-page base form followed by a two-page bodywork evolution; the indexed amendment snippet was incomplete. Base declares 1584 cc, 10.3 compression, twin chain-driven overhead cams and four-speed manual. Native 120 PS JIS at 6400 rpm and 14.5 kg-m at 5000 rpm are retained without modern-net conversion. Rear suspension is explicitly corrected by hand to swing axle, not the struck-through diagonal links. Later grille/lamp evolution, alternate ratios and racing-car equipment/output are excluded. Production recognition describes the road basis, not a currently registered survivor or an event certificate.
cars.summary: The Bellett 1600 GT-R developed Isuzu’s compact road coupe into a specialist twin-cam performance model. Its high-compression four-cylinder engine, fully independent suspension and production homologation make it an important early Japanese sporting coupe with a clear connection to Isuzu’s competition programme.

facts.explanation: The Bellett 1600 GT-R developed Isuzu’s compact road coupe into a specialist twin-cam performance model. Its high-compression four-cylinder engine, fully independent suspension and production homologation make it an important early Japanese sporting coupe with a clear connection to Isuzu’s competition programme.
